title: Colour showcase

chrome.colorsNote: Tiles are on step 2 (bg-subtle) and the page on step 1 (bg), so a tile is one step off a step-1 face. Which role paints each face is ui-materials' rule (ui-materials/references/fills.md), not this source's.

acceptance: Every colour is a variable of the run's system.css or a value read from system.json; the specimens' CSS names no colour.
Every failure in system.json is shown (APCA misses, CVD minima, key-run deviations, anchor flags), and nothing else.
Numbers are read from system.json, never recomputed.
As a layer under another content source, ui-colors gives only the chrome colours and the mode switch.
note: The mode axis lists the modes ui-colors forces with one class: light, dark and dim. Its two contrast modes are not on the axis: ui-colors applies them under prefers-contrast: more and forces them with two classes (.light.contrast-more, .dark.contrast-more), which a class axis, swapping one class, cannot set. Whether to add them is an open decision.
